content:
rai: Uploaded RC artifact rc-2026-04-01-b (gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-b). Quick staging smoke passed. Targeting 03:00 UTC change window. release-notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/rc-b

nina: paste sha + infra pin? any migrations?

rai: sha256:ff77aa9, infra pin: infra:v13.2 (pinned). No DB migrations. FEATURE_SPLIT=false until full promote.

nina: checklist quick: manifests, kv-warm, canary route, telemetry hooks?

rai: manifests pushed, kv-warm job 8821 done, canary 2% ready, dashboards linked in notes. perf smoke ok.

ops-sheriff: i'll cover the 03:00 window. runbook: /runbooks/rc-telemetry-gates. fallback is nina.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion request queued by rai. Prechecks: CI=pass, SCA=pass, kv-warm=ok. Canary scheduled 03:00:00 UTC. Ramp: 2% -> 15% over 7m -> 40% over 12m -> 100% on green. Auto-abort gates: 5xx > 0.8% OR p99 > +220ms OR error-budget burn > 25% in 15m.

rai: staging logs:
```
2026-04-01T02:10:00Z INFO staging start
2026-04-01T02:10:05Z INFO kv warm ok
2026-04-01T02:10:12Z INFO healthcheck ok
```

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary started at 03:00:03 UTC. rc-b-canary (3 pods). Traffic 2%.

nina: initial metrics look clean. running E2E 30 samples.

rai: E2E 30/30 pass at 2%. good to advance.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] ramping to 15% at 03:08 UTC.

ops-sheriff: manual hold at 15% for 5m to watch traces.

rai: at 15% after 5m: 5xx=0.05%, p99 +30ms. telemetry shows a small spike in error budget alerts from a third-party tracer; might be noisy.

nina: i'm seeing a tracer tag misconfiguration — spans tagged double which inflated error counts. paging infra-tracing. hold until they fix.

ops-sheriff: hold maintained. do not proceed to 40% until clean. auto-abort gates still armed.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary ramp paused at 15% (manual hold).

rai: infra-tracing pushed fix; tracer tag dedupe deployed. metrics recalculating.

nina: after dedupe: error budget alerts cleared, p99 back to +28ms, 5xx 0.02%. safe to continue.

ops-sheriff: okay to continue ramp. watch for any other noisy telemetry.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] ramping to 40% at 03:26 UTC.

rai: at 40% after 8m: 5xx=0.12%, p99 +65ms, error budget burn 8%. embeddings downstream stable.

nina: spot quality checks look good. prepare final promote command and release pin update.

rai: final promote commands: `kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-b` and `kubectl patch cm release-pin -p '{"data":{"current":"rc-b"}}'`. Will flip FEATURE_SPLIT=true after 30m bake.

ops-sheriff: if any gate trips during final ramp, rollback command is `kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-prev` and revert pin. deadman auto-fallback = 6m.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] promoting to 100% at 03:40:10 UTC. Pre-promotion check: gates green.

rai: executing promote now.

nina: seeing traffic shift. no spike in 5xx. pin updated, changelog posted.

ops-sheriff: monitoring for 30m post-promo. oncall pager armed.

rai: RC promoted and pinned. thanks team :rocket:

nina: will post perf deltas in #eng-releases in 24h and next steps for FEATURE_SPLIT flip. closing thread. metadata: promoted-by=rai, sheriff=ops-sheriff, tag=rc-b.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] promotion complete at 03:41:02 UTC. Live image: gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-b.
